g.text: Update aircraft status: command forwarded to the owner replica (US105 / B3b)
Peers are tried one by one: 404 = "not mine".
A business 4xx of the owner (400 / 409) is propagated with its status and message.
[status is IN_FLIGHT and target is UNDER_MAINTENANCE / INACTIVE]
409 {"error": "Aircraft CS-TUE is in flight and cannot change to ..."}
409 "The resource was updated by another user. Please refresh and try again."
Unknown registration in every replica → 404. If the aircraft is local, steps 5-10 run in the same
replica without forwarding. Setting a fixed status is idempotent, so retries are safe.
